question: Who was Chairperson of Railway Board as of Sept 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jaya Varma Sinha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Jaya Varma Sinha** became the first woman to be appointed as the **Chairperson and CEO of the Railway Board**, the apex body of the Indian Railways, in September 2023.
 
• She was appointed to the role after a long career in the Indian Railways, spanning over 35 years, during which she held several key positions.
 
• Jaya Varma Sinha is renowned for her expertise in operations and business development, and she played a crucial role in managing the Vande Bharat Express project.
 
• She was instrumental in crisis management during the tragic Balasore train accident in June 2023, where her prompt actions were widely appreciated.
 
• Her appointment highlights the Indian government's focus on promoting gender equality and ensuring representation of women in leadership roles in public services.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Satish Kumar**

 
 
• The name Satish Kumar does not correspond to any known Chairperson of the Railway Board or significant railway official in recent years.
 
• Satish Kumar is a common name and may refer to individuals in other domains, but it is not relevant to this context.
 
 
 
• **Ravneet Kaur**
 
 
• Ravneet Kaur is a senior IAS officer and currently serves as the **Chairperson of the Competition Commission of India (CCI)** as of 2023.
 
• She is the first woman to hold the position of Chairperson in the CCI.
 
• Her work primarily focuses on ensuring fair competition and preventing monopolistic practices in the market.
 
 
 
• **Vasudha Gupta**
 
 
• Vasudha Gupta is an Indian Information Service (IIS) officer currently serving as the **Director General of the Press Information Bureau (PIB)**.
 
• She plays a key role in disseminating government policies and initiatives to the public through media channels.
 
• Her work is unrelated to the Indian Railways but is significant in the field of public communication and governance.
 
 
 
• **Indian Railways and the Railway Board**
 
 
• The Indian Railways is one of the largest railway networks globally and is overseen by the Railway Board, which is responsible for its operations, planning, and development.
 
• The Railway Board is the apex decision-making body of the Indian Railways and works under the Ministry of Railways.
 
• The appointment of Jaya Varma Sinha as Chairperson marks a significant milestone in the history of Indian Railways.
